source: Emulates the Atari Stereo Sound Mod (second POKEY chip at $D210-$D21F on 800/XL/XE). Stock 800/XL/XE has only one POKEY -- leave this disabled for authentic behavior. source: Apply gamepad input hacks required for specific games. 'Dual Stick' maps Player 2's joystick to the right analog stick of Player 1's RetroPad, enabling dual stick control in 'Robotron 2084' and 'Space Dungeon'. 'Swap Ports' maps Player 1 to port 2 and Player 2 to port 1 of the emulated console, correcting the swapped inputs of 'Wizard of Wor', 'Apple Panic' and a few other games. 'Joy 2B+' enables multibutton joysticks support.

'Swap Ports' maps Player 1 to port 2 and Player 2 to port 1 of the emulated console, correcting the swapped inputs of 'Wizard of Wor', 'Apple Panic' and a few other games. 'Joy 2B+' enables multibutton joysticks support.
